item.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'pwd && cat TASK.md && cat solution.py && cat test_public.py'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 -B -c 'from solution import patch_query
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit, parse_qsl
cases = [
(\"/p?a=1&a=2&b=&bare#frag\", [], [(\"a\",\"1\"),(\"a\",\"2\"),(\"b\",\"\"),(\"bare\",\"\")]),
(\"/p?a=1&b=x&a=2&c=&b=y\", [(\"a\",\"3\"),(\"b\",None),(\"a\",\"\"),(\"z\",\"4\")], [(\"c\",\"\"),(\"a\",\"\"),(\"z\",\"4\")]),
(\"/p?%61=1&A=2&a=3&x=keep\", [(\"a\",None)], [(\"A\",\"2\"),(\"x\",\"keep\")]),
(\"/p?x=1\", [(\"雪 +%&=\", \"é 雪 +%&=\")], [(\"x\",\"1\"),(\"雪 +%&=\",\"é 雪 +%&=\")]),
(\"/p?=old&x=1\", [(\"\", \"\")], [(\"x\",\"1\"),(\"\",\"\")]),
(\"/p?a=1\", [(\"a\",None),(\"a\",\"x\"),(\"a\",None)], []),
]
for url, updates, expected in cases:
    original = list(updates)
    for source in (updates, (pair for pair in updates)):
        result = patch_query(url, source)
        assert parse_qsl(urlsplit(result).query, keep_blank_values=True) == expected, result
    assert updates == original
urls = [\"HTTPS://User:pw@Example.invalid:81/a%2Fb?q=1#f%20+\", \"//host/path?a=1#frag\", \"../relative?a=1#x\", \"?a=1#frag\", \"https://host/path?#\", \"mailto:somebody@example.invalid?a=1#frag\"]
for url in urls:
    before = urlsplit(url)
    after = urlsplit(patch_query(url, [(\"key\",\"value\")]))
    assert (after.scheme,after.netloc,after.path,after.fragment) == (before.scheme,before.netloc,before.path,before.fragment)
    assert patch_query(url, []) == urlunsplit(before)
print(\"PASS: 12 query checks (lists and one-pass generators), input immutability, and 6 URL component/empty-update checks\")'"
